cases.text: The process of photosynthesis is how plants make their own food using sunlight. In simple terms, plants take in carbon dioxide from the air through tiny openings in their leaves called stomata. They also absorb water from the soil through their roots. When sunlight hits the leaves, it provides the energy needed to combine carbon dioxide and water to create glucose, a type of sugar that plants use for energy. Oxygen is produced as a byproduct and released back into the air. This process is essential for life on Earth, as it provides food for plants and oxygen for animals and humans.
